messages:
Maya Chen: Morning folks — proposing a "Stairlift Grip Gauntlet" challenge Friday. 15 floors up + 5 min hangboard circuit after. Winner gets bragging rights and granola bar supply. Who's in? :raising_hand:

Leo Ortiz: In. What time? Where's hangboard?

Priya Singh: I'm down but can only do lunchtime (12:30). Hangboard's in the gear closet by conference B. Bring crash pad? :grin:

Maya Chen: Plan: meet 12:25 at lobby, run stairs up, then hangboard circuit in microgym. 3 rounds, timed. I'll keep a sheet. React :one: if you want a "light" version (no stairs), :two: for full gauntlet.

Leo Ortiz: :one: — knee's twingy so light version pls.

FitBot: Maya Chen set a reminder "Stairlift Grip Gauntlet" for 12:15 on Friday. (automated)

Priya Singh: Maya can you add me to the sign-up sheet? https://tinyurl.com/stair-gauntlet

Maya Chen: Added. Also need two extra hangboard crimps and a long strap. Anyone bringing chalk?

Leo Ortiz: I have chalk and a small brush.

Samir Patel: Might be late. If I'm not there, can someone time me? Also can we do a strict 5s deadhang rather than max hangs?

Maya Chen: We'll do 5s on the 3-finger crimps, yes. Samir — we'll start the timer for you if late. Also, quick poll: Should we keep this recurring weekly? React :repeat: for weekly, :no_entry_sign: for one-off.

Priya Singh: :repeat:

Leo Ortiz: :no_entry_sign:

Maya Chen: Cool. Weekly it is if majority. Also housekeeping: please wipe down hangboard after use and return crash pad to storage. See you Friday! :sweat_smile:

FitBot: Reminder: Please sign the safety waiver before using equipment. Link: https://intranet.redwood/fitness-waiver
